title: MODIFICATION OF PUBLIC ACCESS AREAS
previewText: Any public access area may be modified, eliminated or reconfigured over time, provided that such modification, elimination or reconfiguration does not reduce the amount of public access area required under Section 133-60 (PHASING) for the amount of floor area located on the development parcel at the time of such activity.
